items:
Cardinal View by Royal Destinations

Location: Old Seagrove Beach Bordering Seaside Village
Address: 272 West Grove Avenue, Santa Rosa Beach, FL

Details:
With a hard-to-beat location very close to beach access, an incredible private pool, top floor tower with breathtaking views of the Gulf, and a location overlooking Seaside Village, Cardinal View is the perfect home for a vacation like no other. This 8-bedroom home boasts stunning panoramic Gulf views spanning from Destin to Panama City Beach and over 5000 square feet of indoor living space. There is an additional 3000 square feet in porch, balcony and sun deck space. The multiple living areas on each level boast impeccable decor with large spaces to gather together and luxurious accommodations to retreat for solitude and relaxation. Enjoy ample parking and a car charging station for your convenience! The top floor and tower of this home offers stunning views of the 30A community. Enjoy the Florida outdoors by preparing your meals in a summer kitchen by the private pool or an evening cocktail on the oversized rooftop outdoor living space for an unforgettable sunset.

Home Highlights:
-Distance to Beach Access: 0.1 Miles or 528 Feet (3-Minute Walk)
-Parking Spaces: 5 Spaces in Driveway
-EV Charging Station
-Gas Grill
-Elevator
-85in QLED Samsung Smart Television with Theatre Sound (Includes Local Cable with YouTube TV)
-Private Heated Pool
*Pool heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax)
*The pool heater requires 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees.
*Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay.

Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements:
Sleeps: 20
8 Bedrooms / 8 Full Baths / 1 Half Baths / 1 Outdoor Shower

First Floor:
- Bedroom 1: King Suite with Private Bath, Smart TV
- Kitchen with 60in Thermador Range, Dual Dishwashers, Oversized Apron Sink, Extensive Custom Cabinets and Pantry Space
- Dining and Bar Seating for 19 (12 Main Table, 7 Bar)
- Living Area with Wet Bar, Euro-doors to Lanai, Outdoor Kitchen, and Pool (Lounge and Bar Seating outdoors for 8)
- Half Bath and Stacked Washer/Dryer Units

Second Floor:
- Bedroom 2: King Suite with Private Bath, Smart TV
- Bedroom 3: King Suite with Private Bath, Smart TV
- Bedroom 4: Owners King Suite with Private Bath (Vessel Tub, Separate Shower), Sleep Number Bed, Smart TV
- Bedroom 5: King Suite with Private Bath
- Large Living Area w/ Wet Bar (Coffee Maker, Refrigerator)
- Full Laundry Room
- Screened Patio off Living Area and Owners Suite

Third Floor:
- Bedroom 6: King Suite with Private Bath (Balcony with Gulf View), Smart TV
- Bedroom 7: Bunk Room with Twin over Twin Bunks - Shared Bath with Living, Smart TV
- Bedroom 8: King Suite with Private Bath, Smart TV
- Living Area (with Queen Sleeper Sofa), Smart TV

Fourth Floor (Rooftop):
- Wet Bar with Sink, Ice Maker, and Refrigerator
- Table Seating for 12 Guests, 6 Swivel Lounge Chairs
- Panoramic Gulf and 30A Views

Amenities Include:
- 8 Adult Bikes
- Beach Towel Service

Please Note:
Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival.

Lined with artsy villages, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
